logp.method_description: platinum complexes were dissolved and diluted to 50 µM in water, as appropriate for maximal drug stability. Equal volumes of the drug solution and nn-octanol were shaken mechanically in a glass tube for 15 min. Tubes were centrifuged (1500 rpm, 5 min) and aliquots were carefully removed from the top octanol and the bottom aqueous layers for platinum analysis by ICP-AES method at KIST. Partition coefficients were expressed as the log of the partition ratio of total platinum in octanol to total platinum in the aqueous layer.
